## Frequently asked questions

### What is MCP?

Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that lets AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, and ChatGPT connect to external tools and data sources. Think of it as a universal plugin system for AI.

### Which AI tools support MCP?

Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, ChatGPT, Gemini, and any MCP-compatible client. One server works across all of them.

### Do I need to install anything?

No local installation required. Just add the DocuQueue MCP server URL to your AI client's config. Takes under a minute.

### Is my data secure?

Yes. All communication is encrypted over HTTPS. We use API key authentication. Documents are generated on-the-fly and not stored indefinitely. Every API call is logged for audit purposes.

### How much does it cost?

The MCP server is free to use. You pay per document generated (1 credit per document). Start saving time on document creation immediately. See pricing for details.

### Can I generate documents in bulk?

Yes. Use the batch generation endpoint to create hundreds of documents in a single request. Perfect for invoices, contracts, or any high-volume document workflow.
